notes.title: Update 0.2.1a
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29522093/4179518a2c155df07df54dd6b8cc2c35b348c39a.png[/img]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]

[b]New start location[/b]
[list]
[*]Crates with resources
[*]Destructible obstacles "Fungus" and "Cobweb"
[*]Gravitational horizontal lift
[*]Environment objects: architectural elements, plants
[/list]

[b]Mobs[/b]
[list]
[*]“Shammer” - a flying mob imitating small environment objects
[*]“Licker” - the live trap which is hanging down from a ceiling
[*]Waves - the periodical attacks of mobs to a base where they destroy technique and drain energy resources
[/list]

[h1][b]INTERFACE[/b][/h1]

[b]HUD[/b]
[list]
[*]Buttons for switching of screens
[*]Indication of extraction\expend of resources
[*]Indication of damages for squad members and technique
[*]Direction indicators on a location
[*]Focus on interactive objects on a location
[*]The pointer over the member of group who is given the order
[*]Messages about the attack to the base and to drones
[/list]

[b]Screens[/b]
[list]
[*]New screen of squad with buttons for teleportation the members to the base
[*]The pointer of the selected button or the slot and the free relocation on a screens with the gamepad in the Control screen
[*]Displaying of an area for drones when player sends them to a point
Indication of busy drones (at Manufacture screen)
[/list]

[h1][b]CONTROL[/b][/h1]

[b]Keypad and mouse[/b]
[list]
[*]Tab - switching between members of group
[*]Right mouse button - targeting
[/list]

[b]Gamepad[/b]
[list]
[*]B - close
[*]Y - pause or cancel production
[/list]

[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Pathfinding was completely remade
[*]Increased values of shields for drones and turrets
[/list]

[h1][b]Other[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Now when you open context menu, the game is paused
[*]Effects of hits on mobs became more noticeable
[*]Thematic images were added on the loading screen
[*]Music is playing according to the gameplay events 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.01.260a
notes.content:
[b] Update 0.01.260a [/b]	

Added Settings dialog to the Main Menu in which you can change level of graphics details, master volume and switch to system cursor.

Optimized source code which responsible for generation of tiles at the locations. Also optimized dozens of small calculations. All this gives several performance increasing.

Working on optimization is still in progress, so we'll try to improve performance with every update.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29522093/96058d7ad388b2020cc2701395c3d02454921f97.png[/img]
